data.define: Said to show something is perfect, like a great meal.

misuse.text: Don't say 'chef's kiss' about burnt toast.

publish.title: What does "chef's kiss" mean?
publish.value: Chef's kiss = Absolutely perfect. Example: "The soup was chef's kiss." (casual English).
